roadmap.title: Clear the campaign missions
roadmap.description: Learn the turret systems and complete missions through Final Harvest. Take the tutorial gold medals along the way; leave demanding gold targets until the full ammunition selection is available.

roadmap.title: Collect the four endings
roadmap.description: Use White Shells mission replay to obtain every ending. Take peace first to unlock EQKE, then prepare the betrayal attempt before collecting submission and destruction.

roadmap.title: Replay missions for missing gold medals
roadmap.description: Bring powder into budget attempts and earn conflicting medals on separate successful replays. Use each mission’s medal goals to decide which attempt to make next.

achievements.description: Land the Calibration Fire.
achievements.summary: Complete the Calibration Fire mission.

steps.text: Use the supplied coordinates to aim one @item{HE} shell at the marked calibration site. After the hit is confirmed, end the mission at the bed.

achievements.description: Deliver Fire and Light.
achievements.summary: Complete the Fire and Light mission.

steps.text: Use the spotter bearings and impact photographs to hit the three riot groups with @item{HE}.
Fire @item{STAR} over the ceremony in the other city. Adjust the next shot using the correction on the photograph.

achievements.description: Enforce the Liberation.
achievements.summary: Complete the Liberation mission.

steps.text: Use the spotter bearings to locate and eliminate the five infantry groups in the urban sector.
Find the ammunition cache across the river and destroy the underground cache with @item{AP}.

achievements.description: Silence the Counter-Battery.
achievements.summary: Complete the Counter-Battery mission.

steps.text: Restore main power. Plot the three artillery positions and prepare the first shots before opening fire.
Destroy the artillery, then the infantry. When two more artillery positions appear, destroy those guns before finishing the remaining infantry.

achievements.description: Intercept the Iron Road.
achievements.summary: Complete the Iron Road mission.

steps.text: Shoot the train’s destination station to derail the train.
Locate both underground pillboxes from the spotter reports and destroy each with @item{AP}. Sound the @mechanic{War Horn} to start the infantry advance.

achievements.description: Break the Siege of Cartagena.
achievements.summary: Complete the Siege of Cartagena mission.

steps.text: Plot the three priority targets from the supplied bearings and distances. Destroy those targets, then use @item{AP} on both coastal batteries when the batteries activate.
Kill five non-battery enemy units in addition to the three priority targets. Keep two @item{SMK} shells ready, then sound the @mechanic{War Horn}.
Fire the two smoke-support shots at the requested coordinates before their deadlines.

achievements.description: Survive the Gorge.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission The Gorge.

steps.text: Restart the engines, close the leaking steam valves, and restore main power.

Locate the eastern enemy column with reconnaissance and destroy that column. With the calculator broken, use elevation = distance in km × 12 ÷ powder charges; each charge provides up to 5 km of range.

achievements.description: Strike the Rock of Gibraltar.
achievements.summary: Complete the Rock of Gibraltar mission.

steps.text: Plot the reference points from the reports, then use the supplied bearing and distance to locate the anchored cruiser. Sink that cruiser with @item{AP}.

achievements.description: Trust Dead Reckoning.
achievements.summary: Complete the Dead Reckoning mission.

steps.text: Locate the three priority targets from the field reports. Destroy the signal station with @item{DRIL} and use @item{AP} on the anti-aircraft battery and fire control target.
Sound the @mechanic{War Horn} once the priority targets are destroyed.

achievements.description: Answer Fire on Call.
achievements.summary: Complete the Fire on Call mission.

steps.text: Stock @item{SMK}, @item{TEAR}, and @item{HE} before sounding the @mechanic{War Horn}.
Read each support request on the field receiver and fire the requested shells at the specified coordinates. Keep answering requests until the city is captured.

achievements.description: Turn the High Tide.
achievements.summary: Complete the High Tide mission.

steps.text: Prepare @item{HE} and plot a point ahead of each approaching landing ship. Use the ship’s report and your shell’s flight time to fire before the ship reaches that point.
Defend until reinforcements arrive, about 15 minutes after the preparation period. If a ship reaches shore, destroy the troops that disembark.

achievements.description: Endure Blind Fire.
achievements.summary: Complete the Blind Fire mission.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Forward Observers} near each suspected battery to resolve the unreliable initial reports. Plot the four anti-aircraft positions in Valencia and destroy each with @item{HE}.

achievements.description: Hunt the Phantom Battery.
achievements.summary: Complete the Phantom Battery mission.

steps.text: Restart the engine immediately and order @mechanic{Emergency Move}. Use Position Reports from two nearby locations to find your new position.
Locate the Phantom Battery with Forward Observer reports. Prepare both guns with @item{AP} and fire both shells at the battery.
After the impacts, allow at least 30 seconds for the battery to move. Locate the battery again and fire another AP salvo; three or four AP hits disable the battery.

achievements.description: Reap the Final Harvest.
achievements.summary: Complete the Final Harvest mission.

steps.text: Destroy the main station to stop the incoming train. Use armor-piercing shells on the anti-aircraft battery and fire direction centers.
Answer the friendly fire-support request promptly and continue destroying enemy positions until the defenses break.

achievements.description: A city that comes out to meet you.
achievements.summary: Reach the peace ending in White Shells.

steps.text: In @loc{White Shells}, load @item{STAR} with six powder charges. Set bearing @mechanic{66°} and elevation @mechanic{24°}, then fire into Barcelona to trigger the peace ending.

achievements.description: A city that kneels, and calls it peace.
achievements.summary: Reach the submission ending in White Shells.

steps.text: Replay @loc{White Shells} and load @item{TEAR} with six powder charges. Fire into Barcelona at bearing @mechanic{66°} and elevation @mechanic{24°} to trigger submission.

achievements.description: A city spared, and a road no one else will ever walk.
achievements.summary: Reach the betrayal ending in White Shells.

guide.context: The first damaging hit on an ally starts retaliation and removes requisition access. If you run out of ammunition, restart White Shells and buy supplies before attacking.

steps.text: After completing another ending to unlock @item{EQKE}, replay @loc{White Shells}. Use reconnaissance to locate every allied artillery battery and both commanders.

Before attacking, buy all shells and powder. Load one gun with EQKE for @loc{High Command in B4}; prepare the other for allied artillery. Fill both magazines with the APHE or EQKE rounds your remaining targets need.
To gather nearby artillery, fire @item{SMK} near allied units away from High Command. Plot your firing solutions before launching any damaging shot.
Fire on High Command to kill the King and General, then destroy every allied artillery battery. Prioritize artillery and spotting units to extend the counter-battery clock.

achievements.description: A city wiped from the map.
achievements.summary: Reach the destruction ending in White Shells.

steps.text: Replay @loc{White Shells} and load @item{HE} with six powder charges. Fire into Barcelona at bearing @mechanic{66°} and elevation @mechanic{24°}. Wait for the allied bombardment and destruction ending.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Calibration Fire."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Calibration Fire.

steps.text: Calculate the marked calibration shot carefully and hit the target with your first @item{HE} shell. Finish the mission without firing again.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Fire and Light."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Fire and Light.

steps.text: Use two @item{HE} shots to destroy the three riot groups, catching two groups in one blast.
Use two @item{STAR} shots for the ceremony, applying the photograph’s correction after the first. Complete the mission with no more than four shots.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Liberation."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Liberation.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts. A miss or nonlethal shot breaks a killing-shot streak.

steps.text: Replay after Siege of Cartagena unlocks @item{DRIL}. Carry powder in from an earlier completed mission; keep purchases within @mechanic{45 requisition credits}.
Use @item{STAR} to reveal the infantry before starting your streak. Five DRIL, two STAR, and one AP cost 29 credits.

Kill the five infantry groups with DRIL, then destroy the cache with AP. Make all six lethal shots consecutive, keep the average miss distance at or below @mechanic{0.3 km}, and prevent allied casualties.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Counter-Battery."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Counter-Battery.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: Replay after unlocking @item{DRIL}, with powder stocked beforehand. Use DRIL on the nine enemies and keep all purchases within @mechanic{45 credits}.
For the timer medal, prepare the artillery firing solutions before the first impact. Destroy both waves promptly and finish with at least @mechanic{260 seconds} on the counter-battery clock.
For the salvo medal, prepare both guns and plot three enemies before opening fire. Make the three kills in quick succession; use another mission attempt for any medal still below gold.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Iron Road."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Iron Road.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: Replay and derail the train by hitting the destination station. Destroying the train cars directly can remove targets needed for the streak; restart the mission if too few remain.
Before your streak, reveal the towns with @item{STAR}. Make @mechanic{20 consecutive shots that each kill}, with no misses or nonlethal rounds between those shots.
Use another attempt for an average of @mechanic{two enemy kills per shot}, with at least ten total kills. Target clusters; SMK followed by WP can produce grouped kills.
Earn the remaining medals with zero allied casualties and at least @mechanic{19 total kills without Scout Planes}. STAR photographs can reveal enemies during this attempt.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Siege of Cartagena."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Siege of Cartagena.

steps.text: Start a budget attempt with powder carried in. Use @item{DRIL} on the three priority targets and @item{AP} on the coastal batteries; reserve two @item{SMK} for the final support calls. Spend no more than @mechanic{75 credits}.
For the kill medals, destroy at least @mechanic{15 enemies} and reach @mechanic{19 total kills without Scout Planes}. Use STAR photography and Forward Observers to find remaining targets.
Complete a mission with no allied casualties as well. Replay Cartagena for any missing gold rank; the medals can be earned on different successful attempts.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Rock of Gibraltar."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Rock of Gibraltar.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: Bring powder into the mission and buy one @item{AP} for the anchored cruiser and one @item{DRIL} for Lusitania. Those rounds cost 13 credits; keep total spending at or below @mechanic{15}.
Sink the cruiser, then plot Lusitania’s reported position and draw its course at @mechanic{12°}. Pick an interception point 1 km along that course.
Add @mechanic{3 minutes 20 seconds} to the ship’s report time, then subtract your loaded shell’s flight time. Fire DRIL at that calculated time to hit the ship at the interception point.
Finish with both enemy ships sunk, no allied casualties, and no Scout Plane purchases. Replay if the moving ship escapes.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Dead Reckoning."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Dead Reckoning.

steps.text: For the budget medal, carry powder in. Buy one @item{DRIL} for the unarmored priority target (ESS), and one @item{AP} each for the two armored priority targets (EAA and EFC). Those rounds cost 23 credits; keep total purchases within @mechanic{45 credits}.
On a kill-focused attempt, use Forward Observers and @item{TEAR} to reveal hidden infantry. Locate enough targets before firing a streak of @mechanic{six killing shots}.
Destroy at least @mechanic{15 enemies} and prevent allied casualties. Finish the mission to retain the earned medals, then replay for missing ranks.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Fire on Call."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Fire on Call.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: Use @item{STAR} and Forward Observers instead of Scout Planes. Keep friendly units outside every damaging blast.

Before five support requests have succeeded, handle two @item{TEAR + HE} requests by destroying the requested enemies without firing TEAR. These incomplete requests allow additional requests and enemy spawns.

Finish five requests successfully. Continue targeting enemy clusters after the main objective succeeds until you have at least @mechanic{30 enemy kills} and an average of @mechanic{two enemy kills per shot}, with at least ten total kills.
Also complete an attempt with @mechanic{19 total kills without Scout Planes}. If requests stop before enough enemies appear, replay and arrange the two incomplete requests earlier.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "High Tide."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in High Tide.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: Use @item{HCHE} on the approaching landing ships. Aim at interception points ahead of the boats and subtract shell flight time from each boat’s arrival time.
Make @mechanic{six consecutive killing shots}, without missing or firing nonlethal shells during the streak. Keep your average impact distance from enemies at or below @mechanic{0.3 km}.
Prepare both guns to hit approaching ships in quick succession for the salvo medal. Finish the defense, then replay for any medal slot that remains below gold.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Blind Fire."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Blind Fire.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: For the budget medal, bring powder into the mission. Locate the four anti-aircraft batteries with Forward Observers, destroy each with @item{HE}, and keep purchases within @mechanic{75 credits}.

On another attempt, locate enemies through Forward Observers and the photographs produced by the enemy battery’s impacts. Make @mechanic{six consecutive killing shots} before using STAR to reveal survivors.
Kill at least @mechanic{20 enemies} and finish without purchasing Scout Planes. The same attempt can satisfy the @mechanic{19 total kills} requirement for unaided fire.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Phantom Battery."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Phantom Battery.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: Restart the engine, order @mechanic{Emergency Move}, and locate yourself with Position Reports. Use Forward Observers and impact photographs instead of Scout Planes.
Locate and hit the Phantom Battery with paired @item{AP} rounds. Wait for each move, locate the new position, and repeat until the battery is disabled.

Destroy the remaining enemy scouts. Reach at least @mechanic{nine enemy kills}, keep average impact distance at or below @mechanic{0.3 km}, and finish with at least @mechanic{260 seconds} on the counter-battery clock.
For the unaided-fire medal, complete the mission without buying Scout Planes and clear the remaining enemy positions. Check the medal results and replay for any missing gold rank.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "Final Harvest."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in Final Harvest.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: As soon as you wake, load a shell with one charge and fire. Aim to fire within 50 seconds to stay safely inside the @mechanic{90-second} limit; a late first shot requires a replay for this medal.

Order @mechanic{Emergency Move}, then use Position Reports to locate the nest. Destroy the main station and Fire Direction Center 2, followed by the anti-aircraft battery and Fire Direction Center 1. Use @item{AP} on the centers and anti-aircraft battery; destroy Fire Direction Center 3 with AP if active.
Serve the friendly support request immediately. Use STAR and Forward Observers instead of Scout Planes, and prevent allied casualties.
Continue until at least @mechanic{30 enemies} are dead. This also exceeds the 19-total-kill unaided-fire requirement and the ten-kill requirement paired with the fast opening shot.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "White Shells."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in White Shells.

steps.text: Replay @loc{White Shells} for the peace, submission, betrayal, and destruction endings. Each ending awards a different medal; the achievement follows once every ending medal is gold.

achievements.description: Earn gold on all medals in "The Gorge."
achievements.summary: Obtain a gold rank for every medal in The Gorge.

guide.context: Gold ranks carry across successful mission replays, so conflicting medal goals can be completed on different attempts.

steps.text: After repairing the engines and power, use reconnaissance to locate the eastern column. Destroy the eastern enemies, then the optional western enemies, for at least @mechanic{30 enemy kills}.

Keep allies outside your blast areas. Aim for clusters and make @mechanic{ten consecutive killing shots}; also finish with an average of at least @mechanic{two enemy kills per shot}, with ten kills minimum.
To simplify aiming without the calculator, move to a point 5 km from a cluster and use one charge at 60° elevation, or 10 km away with two charges at 60°.
